start_weights: unchanged Qwen3.5-9B base, never the earlier 3-example adapter
entry_gate: at least 24 complete own-answer examples across at least 12 independently distinct configurations
dataset_selection: all audited complete v0 and shape-variant answers; at most two per configuration in the first broad comparison, prioritized by valid proof and actual relation use rather than shorter text; no similarity-only repetitions
optimizer: AdamW, constant learning rate, zero weight decay, gradient norm clip 1
loss_mask: visible final assistant answer and EOS only
checkpoint: single final adapter; no choice using evaluation responses
comparison: unmodified base versus broad SFT with the identical frozen numeric-dev and proof-evaluation prompts, seeds, sampling, and caps
gate_failure: if the corpus threshold is not reached, report candidate yield and do not portray a smaller run as the broad experiment
